scope: Static inspection of pinned public MemTX source, compared with latest v2 primary paper. No third-party execution performed by this audit; parent delegated independent probes.
cache_completeness: 52 selected source/test/driver files, not a complete checkout; do not run full suite against this selected cache.
license_status: No license identified in public tree/API at this commit. No third-party code redistributed.

questions.question: Does commit validate arbitrary read sets or multi-record predicates?
questions.answer: No such validation found. Validation recomputes active beliefs per staged record; its detector compares same entity/attribute slots, authority, validity, scope and dependencies. No general cross-slot constraint checker is exposed.
questions.classification: A stronger multi-record invariant is an assumption/feature boundary; do not label ordinary write skew a violation of a contract that permits partial commit.

questions.question: Are snapshot reads physically pinned to the captured visible IDs?
questions.answer: begin_tx captures visible IDs, while retrieve scans current store/lifecycle/permissions and contains no membership restriction to those IDs.
questions.classification: Candidate implementation-description discrepancy; test a brand-new unrelated record committed after begin, avoiding revocation-as-current-authorization ambiguity. A latest-read description would falsify the discrepancy label.

questions.question: Does empty-snapshot handling preserve late-write rejection?
questions.answer: The detector enables its post-snapshot rival check only when the captured set is nonempty; otherwise normal authority/correction logic can decide.
questions.classification: Candidate boundary discrepancy; use unequal same-slot values, same source or stronger old writer, overlapping validity/scope and sufficient evidence. Include fresh-after-rival and nonempty-before-rival anchors. No test outcome asserted here.

questions.question: Is action validation atomic with external effect acceptance?
questions.answer: The runner calls the gate, then dispatches the mock tool, then records the tool effect as separate ordinary calls. The invariant harness checks these in one API-level transition.
questions.classification: No arbitrary gate/dispatch-interleaving guarantee demonstrated; a TOCTOU probe identifies an enforcement assumption, not automatically a violation of the published API-transition model.

verification_bounds.observed_default_cli: Three records/two transactions/depth8; flags permit the stronger paper-reported bound.
verification_bounds.transition_boundary: Whole manager operations; no OS crash, durable reload, in-flight external operation or model-decision identity stream.
verification_bounds.alphabet: Generated bounded records use one entity/attribute/value; lifecycle/provenance/gate states vary. General arbitrary semantic constraints are not that checked invariant.

runnable_baseline_recommendation: Use the actual pinned MemTXManager for small CPU conformance probes first. Fetch a complete public commit archive before full-suite reproduction; optional tau2 imports and data availability need separate checks. The declared requirements include pytest/hypothesis and broader analysis/model dependencies, but the core schema/manager are standard-library Python.
no_novelty_inference: A confirmed implementation discrepancy would be a bounded public-artifact counterexample. It would not establish a new isolation principle, failure of all memory systems, or journal readiness.
